"""Generate six conventional, variable-pressure brush strokes for the frozen 字 instance."""
import os, json, argparse, time
import numpy as np
from scipy.interpolate import CubicSpline, PchipInterpolator
from PIL import Image
from rcb_brush import Session

PIX=.22185986964255727

def curve(a, speed=7.):
    a=np.array(a,float)
    t=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(a[:,:2],axis=0),axis=1))];t/=t[-1]
    tt=np.linspace(0,1,3000)
    spl=CubicSpline(t,a[:,:2],bc_type='natural')
    root=spl(tt)*PIX
    tangent=spl(tt,1);tangent/=np.linalg.norm(tangent,axis=1)[:,None]
    width=PchipInterpolator(t,a[:,2])(tt)*PIX
    press=(width+.3)/1.187
    offset=np.maximum(0,11.15-.0967*(press-10.91)**2)
    tip=root+offset[:,None]*tangent
    path=np.c_[tip,20-press]
    lens=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(path,axis=0),axis=1))]
    lengths=np.linspace(0,lens[-1],int(np.ceil(lens[-1]/(speed/20)))+1)
    return np.stack([np.interp(lengths,lens,path[:,j]) for j in range(3)],axis=1),tangent[0]

def main():
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('--paths',default='/app/output/paths.json');ap.add_argument('--speed',type=float,default=7);ap.add_argument('--out',default='/app/output/trajectory.npz');ap.add_argument('--score',action='store_true');ap.add_argument('--comp',type=float,default=.0);args=ap.parse_args()
    paths=json.load(open(args.paths));s=Session(instance='/app/instance.json');s.reset();p=s.primitives();s.record_start()
    def move(xyz,speed=.06,settle=3):return p['move_tip'](xyz,speed=speed,settle=settle)
    def world(v):
        x,y=s.geo.mm_to_world(v[0],v[1]);return np.array([x,y,v[2]/1000])
    for i,a in enumerate(paths):
        # Restore the point at the ink stone before each stroke.
        now=s.tip_pose()[0];move([now[0],now[1],.055])
        move([-.1,.150,.055]);move([-.1,.150,.026],.035,5);move([-.1,.150,.055],.05,3)
        path,tan=curve(a,args.speed)
        start=path[0].copy();start[:2]-=tan*3;start[2]=28
        move(world(start),.08,3)
        start[:2]=path[0,:2]-tan*.4;start[2]=21
        move(world(start),.02,5)
        # Cartesian targets follow the inverse of the brush-root offset.
        for k,pos in enumerate(path):
            vel=(path[min(k+1,len(path)-1)]-path[max(0,k-1)])/(.05*(2 if 0<k<len(path)-1 else 1))
            target=pos+args.comp*vel
            q,ok,err=s.ik(world(target))
            if not ok:raise RuntimeError((i,k,err))
            s.step(q)
        p['hold'](5)
        end=path[-1].copy();end[2]=30;move(world(end),.018,5)
        print('stroke',i+1,'steps',s.n_steps,'tip',s.tip_pose()[0],flush=True)
        Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save('/app/output/canvas.png')
    p['hold'](10)
    actions=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(actions,args.out)
    np.savez('/app/output/realized.npz',**{f'stroke{i}':st['samples'] for i,st in enumerate(s.strokes()) if st['inked'] and st['sheet']=='main'})
    Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save('/app/output/canvas.png')
    M=s.ink()>=.5;T=np.array(Image.open('/app/target.png'))[:,:,0]<100
    im=np.full((1024,1024,3),245,np.uint8);im[T]=[150,150,150];im[M]=[30,90,190];im[T&M]=20
    Image.fromarray(im).save('/app/output/overlay.png')
    print('LOCAL IOU',(M&T).sum()/(M|T).sum(), 'STEPS',len(actions),'SHA',s.state_sha(),flush=True)
    if args.score:
        st=s.score();print(json.dumps(st,indent=2),flush=True);json.dump(st,open('/app/output/score.json','w'))

if __name__=='__main__': main()
